_comment: Production registration for the owner-authorized Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and National Security Council (NSC) source families.
These are MANUAL sources: public Daily never fetches afp.mil.ph or nsc.gov.ph.
Private collectors preserve the originals; the signed shared Daily envelope
link metadata and short attributed machine explanations under
config/philippines_daily_policy.json. No original title, body, image,
translation or substantial excerpt enters the public corpus through this manifest.
Registering the sources here gives them the same registry row, run-result row and
liveness disposition as every other production source. It enables no fetch.

sources.notes: Public Daily does not fetch this source. Nothing original enters the public corpus. AFP claims are attributed, not independently corroborated.

Public Daily does not fetch this source. The source posts infrequently: a quiet run is normal, not a failure. The NSC site hosts statements from several offices, so hosting is not proof of authorship.
